name: JupyterLab 4 Data Science Workstation
description: Notebooks with a Python data stack, persistent storage and password login.

PORT.description: Port Jupyter Server listens on. Railway routes the domain and the healthcheck here.

JUPYTER_PASSWORD.description: Login password for the web UI. Generated at deploy; hashed at start and never exposed to notebooks or terminals.

JUPYTER_TOKEN.description: API token for IDEs and scripts (Authorization: token ...). Also accepted on the login page. Leave empty for a random token printed in the logs.

RESTARTABLE.description: Restart Jupyter inside the container when it exits (e.g. File > Shut Down or after installing an extension) instead of stopping the service.

PIP_USER.description: pip and %pip install into ~/.local on the volume, so packages survive redeploys. Set 0 to install into the image (lost on redeploy).

JUPYTER_KERNEL_CULL_IDLE_TIMEOUT.description: Shut down kernels idle for this many seconds (no browser tab attached) to free RAM. 0 keeps kernels running.

GRANT_SUDO.description: Set yes to give the jovyan user passwordless sudo (apt installs). System changes are lost on redeploy; only /home/jovyan persists.

TZ.description: Time zone for notebooks and terminals (e.g. Europe/Istanbul).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Grace period on redeploy so Jupyter can save state and shut kernels down cleanly.
